verdict.rationale: Braintrust's first-party docs describe Playgrounds as a no-code workspace for rapidly iterating on prompts, models, scorers, and datasets. They support running full evaluations in real time and comparing results side-by-side, which covers the core of iterating on prompts against real models. Provider routing through the Braintrust gateway supports the real-model part. missing for 10: explicit documentation of prompt template variables or variable substitution in the playground (datasets only imply input variables), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground workflow.
